news.title: Anthropic IPO - 预期日期、估值及详情
news.snippet: 由前OpenAI高管Dario和Daniela Amodei于2021年创立，Anthropic正筹备IPO，具体日期和估值尚未确定。
news.raw_snippet: Founded in 2021 by former OpenAI executives Dario and Daniela Amodei, Anthropic develops the Claude family of large language models and conducts AI safety research as a public-benefit corporation. The company sells API access, consumer and team subscriptions, and enterprise contracts distributed through AWS and Google Cloud. Backed by Amazon, Google, and venture investors, Anthropic was valued at 183 billion dollars in 2025, making it a closely watched pre-IPO name in artificial intelligence. The company is best known for its Claude family of models and its safety-oriented research posture, which has attracted backing from Amazon and Google in funding rounds reportedly totaling well over fifteen billion dollars. Investor interest in the Anthropic IPO is amplified by the fact that listed exposure to large language model developers remains scarce, with most public proxies sitting one or two layers removed from the underlying model layer. The company sells access to Claude through a consumer chatbot, a developer API, and enterprise integrations, and also distributes its models via cloud partners like Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud.

news.title: 又一家AI公司筹备IPO，投资者须知
news.snippet: AI芯片公司Cerebras正推进IPO进程，这家初创公司专注于高性能计算领域。
news.raw_snippet: # There’s Another AI-Powered IPO in the Works. * Cerebras' retail roadshow featured an endorsement from Sam Altman chief of OpenAI, one of the chipmaker's customers. Cerebras on Monday re-submitted its initial public offering documents with the Securities and Exchange Commission—it initially filed in October, then withdrew—aiming to sell 28 million shares at a price between $115 and $125 apiece.1At the high end of that range, Cerebras' IPO would raise some $3.5 billion, and its implied market capitalization would be over $26 billion. Cerebras' retail roadshow featured an endorsement from Sam Altman, founder of OpenAI, which Cerebras counts as a customer and partner.3 "We believe Cerebras is the best high-speed inference offering in the world right now. And it's hard to overstate how important high-speed inference is," Altman said, referring to a process where a trained AI model makes a prediction or solves a task on data it hasn't seen before.

news.title: Agentic AI如何重塑创始人的角色定义
news.snippet: 自主智能体AI(agentic AI)可能改变创业本质，降低创业门槛，重新定义创始人能力要求。
news.raw_snippet: # How agentic AI could reshape what it means to be a founder. Artists often task apprentices with producing small elements of a larger piece of work – agentic AI can help founders in the same way.Image: Unsplash/Kit. * Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) refers to self-directed systems capable of autonomous reasoning, multi-step planning and execution. * The transition from generative to agentic AI will allow people to delegate entire layers of execution work to tech-enabled tools. * Just like the Renaissance-era painter Raphael delegated to apprentices, AI agents can handle execution so founders can focus on creation. By taking over the heavy lifting of execution, agentic AI could collapse traditional barriers to starting and scaling a business. ## **The rise of the AI-native founder**. ## **Agentic AI and the Raphael model**. China offers one example of how this model could evolve in practice, with the rise of the one-person company (OPC).
